title: Request for Qualifications
owner_action: Authorized bidder must review the current RFQ/eBid instructions and make the required Read and Agree selection; do not infer agreement from this draft.

title: General
owner_action: Authorized bidder must review and make the required Read and Agree selection.

title: Approach, Methodology, and Timeline
owner_action: Prime/bidder must approve methodology wording, staffing assumptions, onsite posture, and integrated schedule before paste.

title: Confidentiality and Data Handling
owner_action: Authorized bidder must review the confidentiality/data-handling clause and make the required agreement selection.

title: Scope of Services - Changes
owner_action: Authorized bidder must review the scope-change clause and make the required agreement selection.

title: Project Proposal
owner_action: Authorized bidder must insert verified team and reference facts and reconcile inclusive total Supplier price/travel before paste.

title: References
owner_action: Provide three verified comparable client references with institution/address/contact/phone/fax/email. Do not fabricate or infer references.

title: Single Point Contact
owner_action: Provide verified managerial single point of contact and key consultant names, qualifications, and involvement.

title: Stakeholders Involvement
owner_action: Prime/bidder must confirm stakeholder roster and that experience-framed wording is supported before paste.

title: Expertise
owner_action: Bidder must confirm this response accurately reflects its substantiated expertise/experience; draft intentionally avoids invented engagement claims.

title: Risk Assessment
owner_action: Bidder must confirm the experience-based framing and integrated project controls before paste.

title: Exceptions to Terms and Conditions
owner_action: Legal/authorized bidder must explicitly decide and document exceptions. Leaving this portal field blank has a certification effect and therefore cannot be auto-selected by this pack.

title: Professional Services Agreement
owner_action: Authorized bidder/legal reviewer must review the UI Professional Services Agreement and make the required agreement selection.

title: Business Associate Agreement
owner_action: Authorized bidder must determine BAA applicability and make the required portal selection; do not infer applicability.

title: Financials
owner_action: Authorized bidder must review the financials requirement and supply the required audited financial statements/annual reports for the previous two years.

title: Offshore Data
owner_action: Provide verified Supplier offshoring/data-access position; this is supplier-specific and must not be inferred.

title: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)
owner_action: Authorized bidder/export-control reviewer must confirm this statement before paste.

title: Compliance
owner_action: Authorized bidder/legal reviewer must review the compliance clause and make the required agreement selection.

title: Proposal Compliance
owner_action: This field is an explicit certification of total compliance except stated exceptions. Authorized bidder/legal reviewer must supply/approve the response after Attribute 15 and all attachments/terms are reconciled.

title: Supplier Information
owner_action: Authorized bidder must review Supplier Information / interpretation rules and make the required agreement selection.

title: Primary Contact Information
owner_action: Provide verified primary account contact name/title/mailing address/phone/fax/email.

title: Purchase Order Contact Information
owner_action: Provide verified purchase-order contact information, or authorized confirmation that the primary contact details apply.

title: Payment Terms
owner_action: Optional field. If bidder chooses to offer cash-discount/payment terms, supply authorized wording.

title: Evaluation Criteria/Method of Award
owner_action: Optional response field; no draft response is required unless bidder elects to add information.

title: Independent Contractor
owner_action: Authorized bidder/legal reviewer must review independent-contractor clause and make required agreement selection.

title: Supplier Background
owner_action: Authorized bidder must review background-check obligation/applicability and make required selection.

title: Proprietary and Confidential Information
owner_action: Authorized bidder must review public-record/confidential-treatment requirements and make required confirmation. Any confidentiality request needs legal grounds and authorized contact details.

title: Preferred Payment Methods
owner_action: Provide verified electronic payment methods available to the Supplier (e.g. ACH/virtual payment capability).

title: University's eSupplier Portal
owner_action: Authorized bidder must confirm acceptance/understanding of eSupplier portal registration requirement.

title: Termination - Non-appropriation of Funds
owner_action: Authorized bidder/legal reviewer must review non-appropriation clause and make required agreement selection.

title: Terms and Conditions
owner_action: Authorized bidder/legal reviewer must review terms and conditions and make required agreement selection.

title: Supplier Parking
owner_action: Authorized bidder must review parking-cost obligation and make required agreement selection.

title: Proposal
owner_action: Authorized bidder must assemble/approve final detailed proposal including verified team, references, total inclusive Supplier price, assumptions, and responsibility split.

title: Audited Financial Statements
owner_action: Authorized Supplier must provide audited financial statements and annual report for previous two years.

title: Fee for Services / Fee Details
owner_action: Authorized prime/bidder must approve final inclusive Supplier price and reconcile travel/expense treatment before portal entry.

title: Supplier Information / binding signature
owner_action: Supply verified legal company/contact/address/phone/fax/email and authorized print-name/signature information. Submission itself certifies authority to bind the company.
